nodes.name: 1. Mathematics
nodes.details: Mathematics provides the foundational language and tools for understanding and building algorithms.

nodes.name: Calculus
nodes.details: Calculus is the mathematical study of continuous change. Used in optimization (Gradient Descent) and probability distributions.

nodes.name: Linear Algebra
nodes.details: The core of Deep Learning. Neural networks are essentially massive matrix multiplications.

nodes.name: Probability
nodes.details: Modeling uncertainty. The foundation of Bayesian Inference and predictive modeling.

nodes.name: Statistics
nodes.details: Collecting, analyzing, interpreting, and presenting data to make informed decisions.

nodes.name: Discrete Math
nodes.details: Foundational logic for Computer Science, graph theory, and combinatorics.

nodes.name: 2. Python
nodes.details: The most popular programming language for Data Science due to its powerful ecosystem of libraries.

nodes.name: Python Basics
nodes.details: Variables, data types, conditional statements, for/while loops.

nodes.name: OOP
nodes.details: Object-Oriented Programming: Classes, Inheritance, Polymorphism, Encapsulation.

nodes.name: DSA
nodes.details: Data Structures (Array, Tree, Graph) and Algorithms (Sort, Search, DP). Mandatory for tech interviews.

nodes.name: Pandas & NumPy
nodes.details: Manipulating DataFrames, multi-dimensional arrays, data cleaning and transformation.

nodes.name: 3. SQL
nodes.details: Structured Query Language. A survival skill for any Data Scientist.

nodes.name: Basic Query
nodes.details: Basic queries: Retrieving data, filtering with WHERE clauses.

nodes.name: Joins
nodes.details: Combining data from multiple tables based on related columns.

nodes.name: Aggregations
nodes.details: Statistical calculations on groups of data: SUM, AVG, COUNT.

nodes.name: Window Functions
nodes.details: Calculations across a set of table rows that are somehow related to the current row, without losing detail.

nodes.name: 4. Data Science
nodes.details: An interdisciplinary field that uses scientific methods, algorithms, and systems to extract knowledge from data.

nodes.name: EDA
nodes.details: Using statistics and visualizations to understand data before modeling.

nodes.name: Machine Learning
nodes.details: Supervised, Unsupervised Learning. Algorithms like Linear Regression, Random Forest, SVM.

nodes.name: Deep Learning
nodes.details: Neural Networks, CNN, RNN, Transformer. Requires a strong foundation in Linear Algebra.

nodes.name: MLOps
nodes.details: Deploying models to production, CI/CD, Docker, and monitoring.
